items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Jack Capp wouldn't record them without me.

ctx.x: I went back to Kansas City with the band and then Andy Kirk received a wire for them to come to Chicago. They went without me. They left me in Kansas City and what I did was join them because Jack Capp wouldn't record them without me.
Had you made any records by yourself at that time?
